title: Correct policy proof HDR fact detection
summary: Harden Policy Proof Pack source/output facts for HDR10+, high-bit-depth video, frame-rate rationals, attached pictures, and clean-machine tool discovery.
reason: Mandatory HDR10+ and 10-bit catalog facts were false negatives on representative public files, equivalent frame-rate rationals produced false VFR evidence, cover art could be selected as primary video, and the documented clean-machine wrapper depended on ffprobe being on PATH.
behavior_before: Frame-only HDR10+ normalized as HDR10; yuv420p10le without explicit bit fields normalized as zero-bit; equivalent rational rates could appear VFR; frame probing could select cover art, accept empty evidence, or run unnecessarily; and the CLI defaulted to a PATH ffprobe.
behavior_after: The probe uses the bundled ffprobe by default, preserves full stream/chapter inventory, samples up to 120 packets from all non-attached PQ video streams, requires PQ plus SMPTE2094-40 for HDR10+, fails closed on failed/empty/malformed frame evidence, excludes attached pictures from technical video facts, and compares positive frame-rate rationals numerically.
tests_added: CLI parsing defaults to the repository-bundled ffprobe while preserving an explicit override.
Equivalent and unknown frame-rate rationals do not produce false VFR evidence.
Failed, empty, and malformed frame metadata probes fail closed.
Frame-level HDR10+ metadata remains associated with PQ stream index zero when multiple real video streams exist.
Frame-level SMPTE2094-40 requires a PQ base transfer before normalizing as HDR10+; SMPTE2094-10 and non-PQ metadata remain non-HDR10+.
Non-PQ media skips the second probe, and attached pictures do not become the technical primary video.
Pixel-format fallback infers yuv420p10le as 10-bit while an explicit positive bit depth retains precedence.
The ffprobe wrapper preserves full inventory while selecting all non-attached video streams for a bounded 120-packet PQ metadata sample.
manual_validation: Canonical summary check passed for both changed Python files.
Focused Ruff passed for the changed Policy Proof Pack source and tests.
Live post-hardening probing with the repository ffprobe re-confirmed the same four approved public source/output facts after non-attached-stream selection and the 120-packet bound.

Live read-only probing normalized the approved public Dolby P8.1 source and its prior preserved output as Dolby Vision 8.1, HDR10-compatible, 10-bit, 480p, six-channel, and not VFR; SHA-256 source bbf334efef9866792f4ab0741c7ce6fbbe0f5d3a149d5941ebbc4d2a30f0d1b0 and output 58ce41aca260935590c6c09dc3f0265b07a07c125851abec85d9229390d3d63d.

Live read-only probing with the bundled ffprobe normalized the approved public FFPictures Lake source and its prior preserved output as HDR10+, 10-bit, 2160p, and not VFR; SHA-256 source ff0aa117f4622387d7d76a33fb6094cb576dab8b8cb59fe18047a614c0e92a5f and output 6576df3dd5c7f700e1c74b691cc6d2335dc1dcb241c01170404254750607c731.
RED follow-up: a multi-video payload reproduced loss of HDR10+ association when the PQ stream and frame used numeric stream index zero.

RED follow-ups reproduced acceptance of zero decoded frames, the bare-PATH ffprobe default, cover-art stream selection, non-PQ dynamic metadata acceptance, unnecessary non-PQ frame probing, and malformed frame payload handling.

RED: focused Policy Proof Pack suite ran 14 tests with six intended failures covering frame-only HDR10+, missing pixel-format depth, bounded two-probe collection, fail-closed frame probing, and equivalent/unknown frame-rate rationals.
GREEN follow-up: numeric stream index zero is preserved and the combined Policy Proof Pack/source-contract suite passed 30/30 unique tests.
Full bundled-Python tooling discovery passed 239/239 tests with three documented release-package dependency skips.
Ruff across src and tests passed; all 2,331 generated summaries and the duplicate-test-name report are current; strict worktree and origin/main diff packet coverage passed.
rollback_plan: Revert the proof-normalization source and focused regressions together; no production media policy, source media, or package runtime state is changed.
notes:
Python impact: validation-tool fact normalization and ffprobe orchestration only; no dependency, schema, runtime API, FFmpeg command-generation, media-routing, publish, or filesystem-mutation change. Discovered with the repository's previously approved public Dolby Browser Test Kit and FFPictures HDR10+ sources. The bounded frame probe counts packets, not decoded frames, and intentionally fails closed when it cannot obtain usable PQ video evidence. The separate MP-CHANGE-2026-0713-003 packet corrects the shared P010 bit-depth fallback.
Regenerate the canonical duplicate-test report after adding focused regressions.
